label: Welcome
description: A fair go in the age of superintelligence: deepen personal understanding, use AI critically and ethically, and help adults build shared capability.

label: Start here
description: Choose an interest, a pace, accessible formats and a realistic first encounter.

label: The sixty days
description: Find every original reading and expanded studio guide.

label: 01 · Personal meaning
description: Life maps, changing selves, embodiment, memory, language and a first teaching encounter.

label: Day 1 · Super people and civic space stewards
description: Connect a personally meaningful interest with a first Aura map, an adult teaching encounter and evidence of a useful next step.

label: Day 2 · A life map with room to grow
description: Build a small, recognisable life collection with meaningful links, review states, stable identities and chosen audiences.

label: Day 3 · Past present and best selves
description: Represent past, present and several possible best selves with their circumstances, resources and distinct meanings intact.

label: Day 4 · Symbols etheric meaning and polarity
description: Give personally meaningful symbols, traditions and patterns of attraction or repulsion a clear, respectful place in the Aura.

label: Day 5 · Embodiment avatar and body real estate
description: Choose an editable avatar and interaction arrangement that feels recognisable and supports the learner's intended activities.

label: Day 6 · Seven shells and meaningful addresses
description: Explain and test the relationship between a record's meaning, stable identity and visible address across Aura views.

label: Day 7 · Memory palaces and reusable paths
description: Build and teach a three-place memory route with source labels, visible ordered actions and a dependable way to return.

label: Day 8 · Language meaning and faithful translation
description: Create a contextual language collection and test whether summaries and teaching translations preserve the person's intended meaning.

label: Day 9 · Sources corrections and knowledge continuity
description: Make a small source collection traceable, correctable and understandable enough for another person or Aura to continue the work.

label: Day 10 · Teaching through a meaningful encounter
description: Teach one personally meaningful Aura capability through a short adult encounter, independent practice and a revision informed by feedback.

label: 02 · Learning and reasoning
description: Attention, retrieval, personal models, evidence, creativity, reflection and transfer.

label: Day 11 · Attention pacing and learning conditions
description: Compare an ordinary learning task under selected conditions and use the observations to design a suitable pacing arrangement.

label: Day 12 · Recall memory and the right context
description: Build and evaluate retrieval routes that return relevant records with their context, versions and chosen audience intact.

label: Day 13 · Models learning and a personal intelligence
description: Trace how selected records, a question, model output and human review participate in a developing personal Aura.

label: Day 14 · A training collection that preserves the person
description: Prepare an example collection with source and permission context, keeping learning examples separate from reserved evaluation material.

label: Day 15 · Reasoning with evidence and alternatives
description: Make a manageable decision inspectable through evidence, alternatives, assumptions, a small practical test and revision.

label: Day 16 · Creative intelligence and futures worth feeling
description: Make two creative versions of a personally or civically meaningful idea, then revise the work using an adult audience's interpretation.

label: Day 17 · Reflective dialogue and the Truth Engine
description: Structure a chosen reflective dialogue so declarations, conditions, observations, interpretations and the person's corrections remain distinguishable.

label: Day 18 · Emotion desire and relational context
description: Describe contextual support preferences and compare responses that suit practical guidance, companionship or constructive challenge.

label: Day 19 · Transfer resourcefulness and unfamiliar tasks
description: Test a capability in two changed situations and identify the knowledge, cues or support that enable adaptation.

label: Day 20 · A first integrated capability demonstration
description: Integrate the first twenty days into a personally meaningful demonstration with traceable sources, correction, transfer, adult teaching and a usable handover.

label: 03 · Tools and worlds
description: Permissioned functions, specialist agents, critique, world models and useful simulations.

label: Day 21 · Tools permissions and purposeful action
description: Specify and rehearse one purposeful tool action whose inputs, effects, permissions and recovery are understandable to another adult.

label: Day 22 · Discovering and defining a function
description: Turn a personally meaningful wish into a versioned function definition with testable inputs, outputs and behaviour when information is missing.

label: Day 23 · Calling functions in a meaningful order
description: Coordinate a small sequence of function calls with visible dependencies, bounded retries and a meaningful human handover.

label: Day 24 · Specialists with complementary capabilities
description: Create complementary specialist roles whose distinct contributions can be traced into one shared result.

label: Day 25 · Mixture of experts and intelligent routing
description: Distinguish neural mixture-of-experts from agent-team routing and evaluate a readable routing decision against a baseline.

label: Day 26 · Critique repair and versioned improvement
description: Use evidence-based critique and bounded repair to improve an artefact while preserving capabilities that already worked.

label: Day 27 · Building a world model
description: Build a small world model whose states, permitted actions and uncertainties support one inspectable event sequence.

label: Day 28 · Three observers and several meanings
description: Separate environment, character attention and narrator interpretation, then use a discrepancy to improve an encounter.

label: Day 29 · Scenarios experiments and transfer tests
description: Create a repeatable scenario pack that tests baseline performance, changed conditions and transfer without hiding assumptions.

label: Day 30 · A multiagent studio with a shared purpose
description: Integrate functions, specialist roles, review and a scenario into one understandable multiagent studio demonstration.

label: 04 · Shared intelligence
description: Relationships, plural values, community twins, reciprocity, adult teaching and leadership.

label: Day 31 · The first permissioned Aura encounter
description: Prepare and review a small, permissioned encounter between two Auras while retaining each person’s control of their context.

label: Day 32 · Plural values and shared decisions
description: Represent plural values faithfully and design a shared decision process that identifies affected people and actual decision rights.

label: Day 33 · Reciprocity affection and evolving partnership
description: Develop a contextual human–Aura relationship agreement that separates companionship preferences from authority to act.

label: Day 34 · Constructive disagreement and repair
description: Practise a repair process that preserves attributed accounts and tests whether an agreed next action improves cooperation.

label: Day 35 · Culture place and the rules that apply
description: Trace a place-based proposal through dated sources, cultural relationships and the people authorised to make relevant decisions.

label: Day 36 · A living community twin
description: Build a source-linked community-twin slice that answers one practical question across physical, service, ecological, permission and rule layers.

label: Day 37 · Contribution reciprocity and the C hour
description: Create a correction-ready C-Hour record that separates voluntary human time, paid activity, learning, resources and observed outcomes.

label: Day 38 · Participatory governance and civic rehearsal
description: Rehearse a civic decision with visible participation, actual responsibility, attributed reasons and a route to review consequences.

label: Day 39 · Teaching adults across different conditions
description: Adapt one demanding adult lesson across three learner contexts while preserving its meaning, independent choice and observable transfer.

label: Day 40 · Leadership and a civic mission brief
description: Lead a bounded civic mission rehearsal through direction, resource allocation, disagreement and a usable succession handover.

label: 05 · Science and systems
description: Compute, distributed memory, scientific inquiry, ecology, resilience and habitats.

label: Day 41 · Frontier compute and a wellbeing hub
description: Trace an ambitious compute workload through physical, service and human dependencies, then explain an interruption to its users.

label: Day 42 · Distributed memory and personal sovereignty
description: Demonstrate that a restored record retains its meaning, history and permissions across a disconnected, distributed workflow.

label: Day 43 · Scientific method as a discovery practice
description: Turn a personally meaningful research idea into a replicable comparison that could change your preferred explanation.

label: Day 44 · Materials etheric intention and mind over matter
description: Develop one traceable materials question while keeping composition, personal meaning and experimentally measured behaviour legible.

label: Day 45 · Longevity life design and continuing development
description: Connect the longevity research horizon with personally meaningful capability, evidence quality and a realistic continuity plan.

label: Day 46 · Ecology regeneration and living systems
description: Model one ecological relationship through sourced quantities, lived knowledge and a comparison of possible changes.

label: Day 47 · Resilience disaster rehearsal and mutual care
description: Rehearse a disruption with clear information handovers, human support dependencies and a reviewable recovery sequence.

label: Day 48 · Planetary twins and changes of scale
description: Move from a local question to a planetary view while preserving each layer's date, resolution and evidential meaning.

label: Day 49 · Space weather instruments and Earth care
description: Connect a dated space-weather observation with a specific civic question without turning a scenario into an operational forecast.

label: Day 50 · Habitats worth inhabiting
description: Design a habitat's daily life and dependencies together, then test how comfort, access and continuity change under pressure.

label: 06 · Frontier stewardship
description: Missions, generality, collective intelligence, autonomy, a practicum and a continuing life.

label: Day 51 · A solar system mission and its civic purpose
description: Connect a solar-system instrument mission with a scientific question, an explicit resource model and a continuing civic purpose.

label: Day 52 · General intelligence through transfer and synthesis
description: Design a transfer evaluation that reveals how an Aura adapts across unfamiliar domains, tools and combinations of constraints.

label: Day 53 · Recursive improvement with visible evaluation
description: Run a bounded improvement cycle with a recoverable baseline, inspectable changes and evaluation that can reveal hidden regressions.

label: Day 54 · Collective intelligence across many minds
description: Coordinate complementary perspectives while retaining independent reasoning, dissent, decision rights and a clear route for new contributions.

label: Day 55 · Distance delay and responsible autonomy
description: Design a delayed-contact protocol that distinguishes local discretion, deferred decisions and durable evidence for later review.

label: Day 56 · A personal frontier design
description: Turn a personally meaningful frontier ambition into a staged investigation that others can understand, challenge and join.

label: Day 57 · Integrating evidence and the development portfolio
description: Build a portable portfolio in which another reviewer can trace a capability claim to evidence, context and a revision.

label: Day 58 · An advanced adult teaching practicum
description: Teach an advanced concept to consenting adults, observe transfer and revise the lesson from learner and observer evidence.

label: Day 59 · Mixed media and a public invitation
description: Create an accessible mixed-media invitation whose story, source trail and release boundaries support a meaningful adult encounter.

label: Day 60 · Continuing as a teacher and civic space steward
description: Choose a sustainable next ninety days that joins demonstrated capability, meaningful life, adult teaching and continuing stewardship.

label: Teaching practice
description: Plan a meaningful encounter, observe without taking over and revise through feedback.

label: Evidence and portfolio
description: Keep sources, versions, corrections and transfer evidence useful to another person.

label: Practical resources
description: Download plain templates for lessons, evidence, functions, rule cards and continuation.

description: Explore the wider Aura, community, care, work and travel references.
